name: The Dark Gold
overview: As mining reforms upend the quiet village of Dayang, ordinary villager Yang Gang is drawn into the dangerous world beneath the mines while trying to protect his family. After he and his brothers uncover a hidden gold deposit, he becomes entangled in a web of corruption, power struggles, and escalating violence. Pressured by powerful figures and shifting loyalties, Yang Gang must navigate a perilous line between survival and morality.
